notes.title: Update v1.0.2.5800
notes.notes:
Added Partial gamepad support 45% (you cannot switch the menu).

Balance
Increased viability percentage to 0.35
Increased intelligence to 0.17
Increased agility to 0.22

Fixed localization in Russian, English.

Minor change
Optimization. The load on the RAM is reduced by 70 mb.
Partial elimination of sound loss (possible if more than 150 daemons are affected)
